answer: Reaching the raven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the ember of a task receipt, and the fable is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, reset on any identity-link attempt, rewards vest against future work.
